text:
Terrible experience. I had a tooth filled on one side. One day later, the filling fell out!! I contacted them to arrange for a fix on the second day (after the procedure). I found out in the evening and they called me the next morning. When I called to confirm the appointment, the staff said the doctor wouldn't be in until Saturday. I confirmed the date, but on Saturday, the doctor wasn't there and said I'd gotten the day wrong!!???? I'd already called to confirm the date. It was awful. The receptionist was unfriendly. The owner is nice, but the system is incredibly slow. Getting a tooth fixed takes two weeks! I've never waited this long at a dental clinic. Maybe it's a corrective case, that's why it's so difficult and takes so long. I wasted so much time; I canceled work appointments with clients just to see the doctor for one tooth. The service was terrible. On the first day, I had to wait for an hour or two. The price isn't cheap, but the service was terrible.
If you're going, ask about the details of the tooth repair beforehand, like how often the doctor is in, and who's most frequent. That way, if you have a problem, things will be faster. After this experience, I'll wait until the tooth repair is finished and never go back again. I'm done with this place. I thought it would be convenient because it's close by, but it was a complete waste of time!
